items.markdown:
`British passport holders visiting Thailand for tourism can enter visa-free for up to 60 days, or apply online for a single-entry tourist visa if staying longer` . Applications are processed digitally via the official [Thai E-Visa Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/).[[1]](https://thetravelvisacompany.co.uk/visas/thailand/tourist/)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa)[[3]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)

Visa Options & Requirements

- **Visa Exemption:** Grants entry for up to 60 days upon arrival without a prior application.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa) 
- **Single-Entry Tourist Visa:** Costs standard processing fees, is valid for 3 months, and allows an initial stay of 60 days with an option to extend by an extra 30 days locally in Thailand.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)
- **Core Documents Needed:** A passport valid for at least 6 months, passport-sized photographs, confirmed return flight tickets, proof of accommodation (such as hotel bookings), and recent bank statements showing sufficient funds.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/publicservice/84256-tourist-visa?page=5d6636cd15e39c3bd00072dd&menu=5f4b6eb3f6ae4b236972c562) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/publicservice/84256-tourist-visa?page=5d6636cd15e39c3bd00072dd&menu=5f4b6eb3f6ae4b236972c562)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xbNwBMAWx-0&t=168)
